name: agent-team-guardrails
description: Guardrails for running a team of AI agents on GitHub without losing control: real human approvals, no conflicts on the shared status file, and an advisor that raises the questions nobody asked.

human_approvers.title: Human approvers
human_approvers.description: GitHub logins of the humans whose approval is required before an agent merges a pull request, separated by commas (for example: alice,bob). Leave empty to turn the merge guard off.
